limits: Read-only source review and synthetic command-output tests only; no real system observation performed by this agent.
observations: Only four fixed systemd units and eight fixed properties are returned; enum and numeric fields are validated.
Only the provisioner journal is queried, at most64 records from20minutes; complete messages and other journal fields are never exported.
Legacy error, exact V3 diagnostic stages and exact success JSON are counted; altered, unknown and non-string messages cannot expose invented private markers.
The fixed worker lock is inspected through lstat metadata only; no human cache, token contents or lock contents are opened.
